title: Deleting a part that got an open return meanwhile is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test with 3 on hand, on no return.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
  • Use a desktop browser that can open a second tab on the same ShopView address, signed in as the same user.
  • Start in browser tab 1 on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. In tab 1, click the part A row.
  2. Open a second browser tab on the same ShopView address.
  3. In tab 2, click Parts in the top bar.
  4. In tab 2, click Returns in the left menu.
  5. In tab 2, click Create Return.
  6. In tab 2, pick vendor A as the Vendor.
  7. In tab 2, pick part A in Part Number.
  8. In tab 2, set Qty To Return to 1.
  9. In tab 2, click Save Return.
  10. Switch back to tab 1 without reloading it.
  11. In tab 1, click Delete Part.
  12. Wait 5 seconds.
  13. In tab 1, click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A in tab 1.

Step 2:

  • A second tab opens.

Step 3:

  • Tab 2 shows the Parts left menu.

Step 4:

  • Tab 2 shows the Returns list.

Step 5:

  • A new return opens in tab 2.

Step 6:

  • Vendor A is picked.

Step 7:

  • Part A is picked.

Step 8:

  • Qty To Return shows 1.

Step 9:

  • The return is saved and not completed.

Step 10:

  • Tab 1 still shows part A's window, opened before the return existed.

Step 11:

  • The delete is refused with a red message "Inventory part with an open return or a pending credit cannot be deleted.", with the second, smaller line "Please try to resolve this."
  • No other error message appears beside it.

Step 12:

  • The red message has gone on its own after about 3 seconds.

Step 13:

  • The window closes and part A is still listed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-N6: “If Delete Part reaches the system while the part sits on a work order, or has a return or credit that is not completed, the delete is refused with "Inventory part that has a work order part cannot be deleted." or "Inventory part with an open return or a pending credit cannot be deleted." Only that message is shown.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Delete refused, part has an open return or credit | "Inventory part with an open return or a pending credit cannot be deleted." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • Story 13, context note: “Context note: every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this." Messages the screen builds itself carry their own second line, as listed, or none.”
